text:
Priya: Heads up — since 10:32 UTC we're seeing a sustained throughput drop (~40%) on rtx-pool-1 for falcon-7b-q4. Multiple workers restarting; a lot of CUDA OOMs showing up. filing here so ops can coordinate.
Ryan: link to dashboards? want to see p95/p99 and restart counts.
Priya: p95 jumped from 120ms -> 320ms and p50 also degraded. restart_count for pool=rtx-pool-1: 52 in last 15m. sample OOM from node gpu-24:
```
2026-03-18T10:34:12Z ERROR cuda_allocator: cudaErrorOutOfMemory: out of memory
stack: runtime::gpu::slab_alloc_failed at slab.cc:342
worker_restart: pid=9876 reason=oom
```
Ryan: :eyes: can you paste the kernel-selection log (we changed selector earlier) and kv cache metrics?
ops-bot: alert: oom_restarts_high — pool=rtx-pool-1 count=52 window=900s severity=high
Jana: I pushed kernel-selector heuristic #4682 at 10:15 (prefers fused-attn kernel for q4 models). Might be causing larger slab allocations for certain sequence lengths. tagging @oncall — any immediate rollback?
Mike: grabbing pprof from the hot node now, will upload. initial look shows big alloc hot paths in fused_attn_fastpath when seq_len > 384. sending quick flame: https://internal/redwood/pprof/2088888888 (private)
Priya: kv_cache_evictions per-node spiked at the same time. counters:
```
kv_cache_hits: 1134 -> 402
kv_cache_evictions: 72 -> 1290
avg_reuse_distance: 1.2 -> 0.3
```
Priya: looks like small-batch surge caused eviction storm, then bigger allocations from fused kernel pushed memory over.
Ryan: can we mark the noisy tenant and drain it from that pool? probe to find top tenants by small-batch qps?
Jana: quick mitigation: pin falcon-7b-q4 to kernel-profile=legacy-fastpath on rtx-pool-1 and disable the new heuristic there. If that recovers, we can iterate.
Mike: rolling back kernel-selector for pool=rtx-pool-1 now (manual override). will monitor. ETA ~2m.
Priya: after override: p95 back down to ~140ms, throughput +85% vs trough. restart_count trend falling. OOMs stopped showing in logs. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident_update: mitigation_applied rollback_kernel_selector pool=rtx-pool-1 user=Mike
Ryan: follow-up action items?
Jana: 1) revert global rollout of #4682 until we have tests for seq_len tail behavior. 2) add unit/e2e that simulates small-batch noisy-tenant + large seq_len mix. 3) dig into kv cache eviction policy; maybe increase per-tenant reservation.
Mike: I'll open a perf regression PR with pprof and test harness attached.
Priya: adding a short postmortem note to the incident tracker, will include timeline and mitigation steps.
ops-bot: incident_resolved: last_event=2088888925 status=mitigated
